summary.zh: 赵匡胤在陈桥驿被拥立为帝，建立北宋。
summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin was proclaimed emperor at Chenqiao Post, founding the Northern Song.

description.zh: 960 年，后周殿前都点检赵匡胤率军北上，在陈桥驿被部下拥立为帝，回师开封，建立北宋。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 960, Zhao Kuangyin, commander of the Later Zhou palace guards, marched north and was proclaimed emperor by his troops at Chenqiao Post. He returned to Kaifeng and founded the Northern Song. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 大理国遣使向北宋贡方物，宋廷册封。
summary.en: The Dali Kingdom sent envoys and tribute to the Northern Song court.

description.zh: 965 年，大理国遣使向北宋贡方物，宋廷予以册封，双方保持通使与贸易关系。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 965, the Dali Kingdom sent envoys and local products to the Northern Song court, which granted titles in return, maintaining diplomatic and trade relations. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋太宗攻辽幽州，在高粱河被辽军击败。
summary.en: Emperor Taizong of Song attacked Liao’s Youzhou and was defeated at the Gaoliang River.

description.zh: 979 年，宋太宗灭北汉后乘胜攻辽，围攻幽州，在高粱河被辽军援兵击败，宋军南撤。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 979, after conquering the Northern Han, Emperor Taizong of Song attacked Liao and besieged Youzhou. Liao relief forces defeated the Song army at the Gaoliang River, forcing a retreat south. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 辽军南下至澶州，与宋订立澶渊之盟。
summary.en: Liao forces advanced to Chanzhou and concluded the Chanyuan Treaty with Song.

description.zh: 1004 年，辽承天太后与辽圣宗率军南下，攻至澶州，与宋议和，获得岁币并维持边界。日期与条款为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1004, Empress Dowager Chengtian and Emperor Shengzong of Liao led forces south to Chanzhou and negotiated with Song, securing annual payments while maintaining the border. Dates and terms follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋辽在澶州议和，订立澶渊之盟。
summary.en: Song and Liao negotiated the Chanyuan Treaty at Chanzhou.

description.zh: 1004 年，辽军南下至澶州，宋真宗亲征，宋辽议和，约定维持边界、宋每年输辽岁币。日期与条款为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1004, Liao forces advanced to Chanzhou. Emperor Zhenzong of Song went to the front, and the two sides negotiated the Chanyuan Treaty, fixing the border and requiring Song annual payments to Liao. Dates and terms follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 李元昊称帝，国号大夏，定都兴庆府。
summary.en: Li Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor, founded the state of Daxia, and made Xingqing his capital.

description.zh: 1038 年，党项首领李元昊在兴庆府称帝，国号大夏，宋称西夏，与宋、辽形成鼎立。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1038, the Tangut leader Li Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor at Xingqing, named his state Daxia, and formed a tripartite balance with Song and Liao. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋军在好水川被西夏军伏击，损失惨重。
summary.en: The Song army was ambushed by Western Xia forces at Haoshuichuan and suffered heavy losses.

description.zh: 1040 年，西夏李元昊率军南下，宋军任福部追击至好水川，被西夏军伏击，宋军大败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1040, Li Yuanhao of Western Xia led forces south. The Song commander Ren Fu pursued to Haoshuichuan and was ambushed, suffering a major defeat. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋夏议和，西夏向宋称臣，宋每年赐予银绢。
summary.en: Song and Western Xia made peace, with Xia nominally submitting and Song paying annual silver and silk.

description.zh: 1044 年，宋夏经过长期战争后议和，西夏向宋称臣，宋每年赐银、绢、茶，史称庆历和议。日期与条款为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1044, after years of war, Song and Western Xia negotiated peace. Xia nominally submitted to Song, which provided annual silver, silk, and tea. Dates and terms follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋神宗任用王安石推行新法。
summary.en: Emperor Shenzong of Song appointed Wang Anshi to carry out reforms.

description.zh: 1069 年，宋神宗任用王安石为参知政事，推行青苗、募役、保甲等新法，引发长期党争。日期与措施为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1069, Emperor Shenzong appointed Wang Anshi as vice chancellor and launched the green sprouts, hired service, and baojia reforms, triggering prolonged factional conflict. Dates and measures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋军围攻灵州，西夏决黄河水灌宋营，宋军溃退。
summary.en: Song forces besieged Lingzhou; Western Xia diverted the Yellow River and routed them.

description.zh: 1081 年，北宋五路伐夏，刘昌祚部进围灵州，西夏决黄河水灌宋军营地，宋军补给断绝，大败而退。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1081, the Northern Song launched a five-route campaign against Western Xia. Liu Changzuo besieged Lingzhou, but Western Xia diverted the Yellow River into the Song camps, cutting supplies and forcing a retreat. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 西夏倾国进攻永乐城，宋军大败。
summary.en: Western Xia attacked Yongle with its full strength and destroyed the Song garrison.

description.zh: 1082 年，宋将徐禧在永乐川筑城，西夏倾国来攻，切断水源，宋军大败，永乐城陷落。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1082, the Song general Xu Xi built a fortress at Yongle. Western Xia attacked with its full strength, cut off the water supply, and destroyed the Song force, taking the fortress. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Gao Shengtai usurps the Dali throne

summary.zh: 权臣高升泰废段正明，建立大中国，后还政段氏。
summary.en: The minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and briefly founded the state of Dazhong.

description.zh: 1096 年，大理权臣高升泰废段正明，自立为帝，国号大中国；其后高氏还政段氏，大理国进入后理国时期。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1096, the Dali minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and proclaimed himself emperor of Dazhong. The Gao family later returned power to the Duan, beginning the Later Dali period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 完颜阿骨打起兵攻辽，攻克宁江州。
summary.en: Wanyan Aguda rose against Liao and captured Ningjiangzhou.

description.zh: 1114 年，女真完颜部首领阿骨打起兵反辽，率军攻克宁江州，成为金灭辽战争的起点。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1114, Wanyan Aguda, leader of the Jurchen Wanyan tribe, rose against Liao and captured Ningjiangzhou, beginning the war that would destroy Liao. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 方腊在睦州起义，攻占江南多州。
summary.en: Fang La rose at Muzhou and captured several prefectures in Jiangnan.

description.zh: 1120 年，方腊在睦州青溪起义，以摩尼教组织民众，攻占杭州等地，宋廷调军镇压。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1120, Fang La rose in Qingxi, Muzhou, organized followers through Manichaeism, and captured Hangzhou and other places before the Song court sent troops to suppress the rebellion. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 金灭辽后，西夏向金称臣。
summary.en: After Jin destroyed Liao, Western Xia submitted to Jin.

description.zh: 1124 年，金灭辽后，西夏审时度势向金称臣，保持割据，金夏之间形成长期的和战关系。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1124, after Jin destroyed Liao, Western Xia submitted to Jin while retaining autonomy, beginning a long relationship of peace and war. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 金军攻占燕京，辽天祚帝被俘，辽朝灭亡。
summary.en: Jin forces took Yanjing and captured Emperor Tianzuo, ending the Liao dynasty.

description.zh: 1125 年，金军继续西进，辽天祚帝在应州被俘，辽朝灭亡，金与北宋直接接壤。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1125, Jin forces advanced west and captured Emperor Tianzuo of Liao at Yingzhou, ending the Liao dynasty and bringing Jin into direct contact with the Northern Song. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 金军围攻太原，宋军坚守多月后城破。
summary.en: Jin forces besieged Taiyuan, which fell after months of Song resistance.

description.zh: 1126 年，金军分路南下，围攻太原，宋军坚守数月，最终城破，金军得以长驱南下。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1126, Jin forces advanced south along several routes and besieged Taiyuan. The Song garrison held out for months before the city fell, opening the way for a deeper Jin advance. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 金军攻破开封，掳走徽钦二帝，北宋灭亡。
summary.en: Jin forces captured Kaifeng and took the Song emperors, ending the Northern Song.

description.zh: 1127 年，金军攻破开封，掳走宋徽宗、宋钦宗及宗室北去，北宋灭亡，赵构在南方建立南宋。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1127, Jin forces captured Kaifeng and took Emperor Huizong, Emperor Qinzong, and the imperial clan north, ending the Northern Song. Zhao Gou then established the Southern Song in the south. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 韩世忠在黄天荡阻击金军水师。
summary.en: Han Shizhong blocked the Jin fleet at Huangtiandang.

description.zh: 1130 年，韩世忠率宋军水师在黄天荡拦截北撤的金军，相持四十余日，金军最终掘渠脱走。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1130, Han Shizhong led the Song navy to block the withdrawing Jin fleet at Huangtiandang. The standoff lasted more than forty days before the Jin forces dug a channel and escaped. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 金军在富平击败宋军，控制陕西。
summary.en: Jin forces defeated the Song army at Fuping and took control of Shaanxi.

description.zh: 1130 年，金军进攻陕西，宋军集结富平迎战，因指挥失误被金军击败，陕西大部落入金朝控制。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1130, Jin forces attacked Shaanxi. The Song army massed at Fuping but was defeated through command failures, leaving most of Shaanxi under Jin control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 刘锜在顺昌以少胜多，击退金军。
summary.en: Liu Qi defeated a larger Jin force at Shunchang.

description.zh: 1140 年，金军南下，刘锜率宋军坚守顺昌，以少胜多击退金军，成为宋金战争中的著名防御战。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1140, Jin forces advanced south. Liu Qi led the Song defense at Shunchang and defeated a larger Jin army, making it a famous defensive battle of the Song-Jin wars. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 岳飞在郾城大败金军骑兵。
summary.en: Yue Fei defeated Jin cavalry at Yancheng.

description.zh: 1140 年，岳飞率岳家军北伐，在郾城以步骑协同大破金军拐子马与铁浮图。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1140, Yue Fei led his army north and defeated Jin’s armored cavalry at Yancheng through coordinated infantry and cavalry tactics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 南宋与金议和，以淮水、大散关为界。
summary.en: The Southern Song and Jin made peace, fixing the border at the Huai River and Dasan Pass.

description.zh: 1141 年，南宋与金达成绍兴和议，东以淮水、西以大散关为界，宋向金称臣纳贡。日期与条款为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1141, the Southern Song and Jin concluded the Shaoxing Peace, fixing the border along the Huai River in the east and Dasan Pass in the west, with Song as a subordinate paying tribute. Dates and terms follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 岳飞被以“莫须有”罪名杀害。
summary.en: Yue Fei was executed on fabricated charges.

description.zh: 1142 年，南宋朝廷在议和背景下将岳飞下狱，以“莫须有”罪名杀害，成为宋金和议的悲剧注脚。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1142, amid the peace negotiations, the Southern Song court imprisoned Yue Fei and executed him on fabricated charges, a tragic episode of the Song-Jin peace. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 完颜亮南侵，在采石渡江失败。
summary.en: Wanyan Liang’s southern campaign failed in its Yangtze crossing at Caishi.

description.zh: 1161 年，金主完颜亮率大军南下，企图自采石渡江，被宋军水师击退，随后金军内部发生政变，完颜亮被杀。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1161, Jin emperor Wanyan Liang led a major southern campaign and attempted to cross the Yangtze at Caishi. The Song navy repelled the crossing, and a coup soon led to Wanyan Liang’s death. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 虞允文在采石组织宋军击退金军渡江。
summary.en: Yu Yunwen organized the Song defense and repelled the Jin river crossing at Caishi.

description.zh: 1161 年，金主完颜亮率军南下，虞允文在采石整顿宋军，以水战击退金军渡江，金军后因内乱退走。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1161, Jin emperor Wanyan Liang advanced south. Yu Yunwen rallied the Song forces at Caishi and defeated the Jin attempt to cross the Yangtze, and the Jin army withdrew after internal strife. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 宋孝宗发动隆兴北伐，在宿州失利。
summary.en: Emperor Xiaozong of Song launched the Longxing expedition, which failed at Suzhou.

description.zh: 1163 年，宋孝宗即位后发动隆兴北伐，宋军初胜后因将领不和在宿州大败，最终与金朝再订和议。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1163, Emperor Xiaozong launched the Longxing northern expedition. After initial success, the Song army was routed at Suzhou because of disagreements among commanders, leading to another peace with Jin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 成吉思汗攻西夏，围中兴府，西夏纳女求和。
summary.en: Genghis Khan invaded Western Xia, besieged Zhongxing, and accepted a marriage peace.

description.zh: 1209 年，成吉思汗率蒙古军攻西夏，包围中兴府，西夏献女求和，暂避灭国之祸。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1209, Genghis Khan led Mongol forces against Western Xia and besieged Zhongxing. Western Xia sued for peace by offering a princess, postponing its destruction. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 成吉思汗在野狐岭大败金军。
summary.en: Genghis Khan defeated the Jin army at Yehuling.

description.zh: 1211 年，成吉思汗率蒙古军南下攻金，在野狐岭击溃金军主力，为蒙古深入华北打开通道。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1211, Genghis Khan led the Mongols south against Jin and routed the main Jin army at Yehuling, opening the way into North China. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 蒙古军攻占金中都，金廷南迁。
summary.en: The Mongols captured Jin’s central capital, and the Jin court moved south.

description.zh: 1215 年，蒙古军攻占金中都，金宣宗此前已迁都汴京，金朝在华北的统治受到重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1215, the Mongols captured Jin’s central capital. Emperor Xuanzong had already moved the court to Kaifeng, and Jin’s control of North China was severely weakened. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 蒙古军围中兴府，西夏末帝投降，西夏灭亡。
summary.en: Mongol forces took Zhongxing and ended Western Xia.

description.zh: 1227 年，蒙古军围困中兴府，西夏末帝李睍投降，西夏灭亡；成吉思汗也在同年去世。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1227, Mongol forces besieged Zhongxing, and the last Western Xia emperor Li Xian surrendered, ending the state. Genghis Khan died the same year. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《宋史》
sources.author: 脱脱等
sources.note: 宋代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 蒙古军在三峰山歼灭金军主力。
summary.en: The Mongols destroyed the main Jin army at Sanfeng Mountain.

description.zh: 1231 年，蒙古军追击金军至三峰山，乘大雪包围并歼灭金军主力，金朝精锐损失殆尽。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1231, Mongol forces pursued the Jin army to Sanfeng Mountain and, in heavy snow, surrounded and destroyed its main force, leaving Jin without its elite troops. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 蒙古与南宋联军攻破蔡州，金朝灭亡。
summary.en: Mongol and Southern Song forces captured Caizhou, ending the Jin dynasty.

description.zh: 1234 年，蒙古与南宋联军围攻蔡州，金哀宗传位后自尽，金朝灭亡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1234, Mongol and Southern Song forces besieged Caizhou. Emperor Aizong of Jin abdicated and took his own life, ending the Jin dynasty. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 蒙古军攻灭大理国，形成对南宋的西南包围。
summary.en: The Mongols conquered the Dali Kingdom, creating a southwestern flank against the Southern Song.

description.zh: 1253 年，忽必烈率蒙古军经川西高原南下，攻灭大理国，为蒙古从西南包抄南宋创造条件。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1253, Kublai led Mongol forces south through the western Sichuan plateau and conquered the Dali Kingdom, creating a southwestern route around the Southern Song. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 忽必烈率蒙古军攻破大理城，大理国灭亡。
summary.en: Kublai’s Mongol forces captured Dali, ending the kingdom.

description.zh: 1253 年，忽必烈率蒙古军经川西高原南下，革囊渡江，攻破大理城，大理国灭亡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1253, Kublai led Mongol forces south through the western Sichuan plateau, crossed the Yangtze with inflated skins, and captured Dali, ending the kingdom. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Duan family submits to the Mongols

summary.zh: 段兴智被俘后降蒙，受命管理大理。
summary.en: Duan Xingzhi was captured and submitted, later governing Dali for the Mongols.

description.zh: 1254 年，大理末主段兴智被俘后降蒙，蒙古任命段氏继续管理大理，段氏世袭土官地位由此延续。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1254, the last Dali ruler Duan Xingzhi was captured and submitted to the Mongols, who let the Duan family continue to administer Dali, beginning their long hereditary role. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 蒙古军围攻钓鱼城受阻，蒙哥汗死于军中。
summary.en: The Mongol siege of Diaoyucheng stalled, and Möngke Khan died in camp.

description.zh: 1259 年，蒙哥汗率军围攻合州钓鱼城，宋军坚守数月，蒙哥汗在军中去世，蒙古军撤退。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1259, Möngke Khan besieged Diaoyucheng in Hezhou. The Song garrison held out for months, and Möngke died in camp, prompting a Mongol withdrawal. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军攻破襄阳，南宋长江中游防线崩溃。
summary.en: Yuan forces captured Xiangyang, collapsing the Southern Song’s middle Yangtze defense.

description.zh: 1273 年，元军长期围困襄阳，使用回回炮攻破樊城、襄阳，南宋长江中游门户洞开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1273, Yuan forces broke the long siege of Xiangyang, using counterweight trebuchets to take Fancheng and Xiangyang and opening the middle Yangtze to invasion. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军自襄阳南下，渡江攻占鄂州。
summary.en: Yuan forces moved south from Xiangyang, crossed the Yangtze, and took Ezhou.

description.zh: 1274 年，元军在襄阳陷落后沿汉水南下，渡长江攻占鄂州，南宋长江防线全面动摇。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1274, after the fall of Xiangyang, Yuan forces moved down the Han River, crossed the Yangtze, and captured Ezhou, shaking the entire Southern Song river defense. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军在丁家洲大败南宋水军，直逼临安。
summary.en: Yuan forces routed the Southern Song navy at Dingjiazhou and advanced on Lin’an.

description.zh: 1275 年，元军沿江东下，在丁家洲击败南宋水军主力，宋军溃败，临安门户洞开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1275, Yuan forces advanced east along the Yangtze and defeated the main Southern Song fleet at Dingjiazhou. The Song army collapsed, leaving Lin’an exposed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军进逼临安，南宋朝廷投降。
summary.en: Yuan forces approached Lin’an, and the Southern Song court surrendered.

description.zh: 1276 年，元军攻至临安，谢太后与宋恭帝出降，南宋朝廷投降，残余势力继续南逃。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1276, Yuan forces reached Lin’an. Empress Dowager Xie and Emperor Gong surrendered, while remaining Song loyalists fled south. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 元军围攻崖山，南宋最后抵抗失败。
summary.en: Yuan forces attacked Yamen, ending the last Southern Song resistance.

description.zh: 1279 年，元军与南宋残部在崖山海战，宋军大败，陆秀夫负幼帝投海，南宋灭亡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1279, Yuan forces defeated the remaining Southern Song fleet at Yamen. Lu Xiufu jumped into the sea with the child emperor, ending the Southern Song. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
